primitives.name: Schema-Model Table Alignment
primitives.verbatim_quote: The headline is a **clean sweep on the two things that would be unrecoverable**: every model has a `CREATE TABLE` in migrations, and every one of the 57 models carrying a `@unique` has a matching UNIQUE index/constraint in migration SQL.
primitives.assumptions: Each model maps to a single table; all unique constraints are enforced via SQL indexes.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Zero schema drift detected; all models resolved to migration-created tables.

layer2.mapping: Bijective function f: M → T such that ∀m ∈ M, f(m) = t ∈ T where t is created by migration SQL.
layer2.telemetry: Migration SQL CREATE TABLE count matches model count.

primitives.name: N+1 Query Elimination
primitives.verbatim_quote: **NO N+1 ON ANY USER-FACING PATH.** `apps/web/lib/board/state.ts` has exactly one `await db.` at :513.
primitives.assumptions: All user-facing paths contain ≤1 await db. operation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: No N+1 patterns in request paths; batch operations confined to cron lanes.

layer2.mapping: Kernel function k: P → Q such that ∀p ∈ P, k(p) = q where q is bounded by single DB access.
layer2.telemetry: Count of await db. operations per path.

primitives.name: Safe Delete Guardiance
primitives.verbatim_quote: **SAFE DELETES ALREADY GUARDED.** P4-8/F1 found `historical-games.ts:98 deleteMany({})` guarded on *emptiness* not *completeness*, and deliberately did not fix it.
primitives.assumptions: Delete operations are guarded by emptiness checks; no cascading delete paths exist in product code.
primitives.breakdown_regime: No live delete paths trigger cascades; deletion safety ensured by guard condition.

layer2.mapping: Guard function g: D → G such that g(D) = true iff D is safe for execution.
layer2.telemetry: Presence of deleteMany({}) with emptiness check.
